subject: advisor.history_text: please read history.jsonl (Track P prompt arm)
body: R1-P-prompt and Taste-Bench --decider prompt get their history from advisor.history_text, which reads only choices.jsonl. Track P can't write there: choices.jsonl is the feature-vector format, and cli build_profile crashes on text rows. 'trackp fit' now writes data/researchers/<slug>/history.jsonl: text Choice rows (context, a_text, b_text, chosen, reason), exactly the history+val the user model was fitted on, with held-out choices excluded. Could history_text also read history.jsonl? Your existing a_text/b_text branch already formats these rows, so it's about a 3-line change. Also, load_model checks that the backend matches, so the loop's judge backend/model has to be the one 'trackp fit --backend/--model' used.
